replies.body:
You're right — with 117.removed / 110.removed the code reading the opt-in is already gone, so rather than changing the default I'll drop the `semconv` plumbing (the `OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN` mapping) from the helper entirely.

The two remaining explicit `semconv` call sites — anthropic's `stable` fixture and openai's content-mode parametrization — should be no-ops now that nothing reads the flag, so I'd clean those up in the same pass.

Confirmed — `content_capture` alone is enough, and nothing reads `OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN` anymore (its code was removed from util-genai and google-genai; no instrumentation src reads it). So I dropped the `semconv` / `OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN` plumbing from the helper and the now-dead `semconv=` call sites, including anthropic's `stable` fixture, in the latest commit.

One deliberate non-change: I left the openai `content_mode` fixture's tuple shape intact — its parametrize id is what the VCR cassette filenames key off, so reshaping it would orphan ~40 cassettes. Its now-unused flag (and the leftover `OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN` setenvs in the langchain/openai tests) are dead too; happy to clean those up in a follow-up if you'd like.

Resolving this thread.
